user.title: Queue Management
user.description: Set up Queue Management. You can create additional queues later via services or the UI.

init.title: Queue Management Options
init.description: Currently no options. Use services to manage queues.

take_ticket.name: Take ticket
take_ticket.description: Issue the next ticket number for a queue.

call_next.name: Call next
call_next.description: Call the next waiting ticket in the queue.

reset_queue.name: Reset queue
reset_queue.description: Reset a queue to its starting number and clear waiting tickets.

queue_id.name: Queue ID
queue_id.description: Unique ID for the queue (lowercase, no spaces).

name.name: Display name
name.description: Friendly name shown in the UI.

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.description: Optional prefix for ticket numbers (e.g. A, VIP).

delete_queue.name: Delete queue
delete_queue.description: Delete a queue (cannot delete the main queue).

queue_id.name: Queue ID
queue_id.description: ID of the queue to delete.
